handwriting.title: Handwriting forensic expertise
handwriting.description: Handwriting forensic expertise is a tool for identifying the author of handwritten text or signature. Experts analyze handwritten and digital records to solve identification, diagnostic and classification tasks.

phonography.title: Phonographic forensic expertise
phonography.description: Phonographic expertise studies audio information on digital or magnetic media to determine key facts, transcribe unclear speech, identify speakers and detect editing.

phototechnical.title: Phototechnical forensic expertise
phototechnical.description: Phototechnical expertise focuses on photo, cinema and video material analysis and the equipment used to create them, including detection of edits and evaluation of shooting conditions.

accounting.title: Accounting forensic expertise
accounting.description: Accounting forensic expertise analyzes financial and business activities to verify correctness of accounting records and determine financial damages.

goods.title: Commodity forensic expertise
goods.description: Commodity expertise determines product characteristics, compliance with standards, defect analysis and valuation.

religion.title: Religious studies forensic research
religion.description: Systematic analysis to determine affiliation of materials to specific religious movements and to assess potentially dangerous rhetoric.

psychology.title: Psychological forensic expertise
psychology.description: Psychological expertise examines mental states and abilities of subjects to establish facts with legal significance.

history.title: history
paragraphs: ANSE was established in 2021 as an independent platform to develop private forensic expertise in Kazakhstan. The founders are professionals with over twenty years of experience in the state expert system, who progressed from practicing experts to leaders. The move to an independent format allowed building an organization based on professionalism, transparency and personal responsibility, with quality control and scientific approach becoming part of corporate culture.
Today ANSE is an interregional forensic organization combining specialists with long-term practice and a scientific approach to research.

mission.title: mission
mission.intro: The Alliance is a professional community where truth is not a legal category but a value at the core of the profession. Professionalism, methodology and ethics form the foundation of a new culture of evidence in forensic activity.

values.title: Professionalism

values.title: Objectivity and independence
values.description: Each conclusion is based on facts, scientific data and strict compliance with legislation.

values.title: Individual approach

forAuthors.title: Guidelines for Authors
forAuthors.lead: The scientific and practical journal “EXPERTUS” is the official publication of the LLP “Alliance of Independent Forensic Expertise”, dedicated to forensic expert activity, research methodology, and practical application in legal proceedings.
forAuthors.audience: The journal is practice-oriented and focused on professional analysis and the development of the expert community in the Republic of Kazakhstan and abroad.

general.title: 1. General requirements
general.intro: The journal “EXPERTUS” accepts original scientific and scientific-practical materials, including:
acceptedTypes: reviews of judicial and forensic practice;
materialRequirements: not be under consideration by other journals.
reviewStages: peer review in accordance with the journal’s editorial policy.
general.consentNote: Submission of a manuscript implies the author’s consent to the journal’s editorial and ethical policy.

topics.title: 2. Journal scope
topics.intro: The journal publishes materials in the following areas:
items: procedural and legal issues of forensic expertise;
methodology and practice of expert research;
analysis of court decisions and expert cases;
sectoral types of forensic examinations (construction and technical, medical, psychological and pedagogical, economic, environmental, engineering, land management, commodity expertise, etc.);
international experience and standards in forensic expertise (ISO, ENFSI, etc.);
digitalization, software products, and artificial intelligence in expert activity;

manuscript.title: 3. Manuscript requirements
manuscript.minVolume: Minimum article length: at least 6 pages (excluding abstracts and references).
manuscript.format: 3.2. Format: A4 page size, portrait orientation.

structure.title: 4. Article structure
structure.intro: The article must include the following elements:
items: author information (full name, organization, position, city, country, e-mail);
description of materials and/or research methods;
if needed, appendices, tables, diagrams, and illustrations.

abstract.title: 5. Abstract and keywords
items: main results and their practical significance;

references.title: 6. References and bibliography
references.intro: The abstract must be written in the third person, without references or abbreviations.
references.gost: Formatting is carried out according to GOST 7.1–2003.
listRules: international sources and standards are encouraged;
sources must be formatted in accordance with GOST requirements.

visuals.title: 7. Tables, figures, and diagrams
items: all figures and tables must be numbered and captioned;
images should be high quality (recommended at least 300 dpi);
tables must be provided in editable format;
the source must be indicated when borrowing content.

publicationLanguages.title: 8. Publication languages
publicationLanguages.intro: After the main article text and reference list, the following must be provided:
items: in two additional languages (Kazakh, Russian, English — depending on the language of the main article).

originality.title: 9. Originality requirements
originality.intro: Each article is checked using software tools. The minimum originality level is at least 80% (excluding references). Materials showing signs of plagiarism or self-plagiarism are rejected.

ethics.title: 10. Ethical standards
ethics.intro: The journal adheres to the principles of publication ethics and professional integrity.
ethics.editorialRight: The editorial board reserves the right to reject, revise, or retract publications if violations are identified.

copyright.title: 11. Copyright
copyright.intro: Authors retain copyright to published materials. The journal receives the right of first publication and distribution of the material with mandatory attribution.

submission.title: 12. Submission of materials
submission.deadline: Submission deadlines are announced separately for each issue.
